whyWeExistSection.heading: Why We Exist
whyWeExistSection.text: Food insecurity affects thousands of families in our community. Rising costs of living, unexpected job loss, medical emergencies, and systemic barriers can push anyone into a situation where they struggle to put food on the table.
whyWeExistSection.text2: CAWAP Food Bank was established to bridge this gap, ensuring that every person in our community has access to fresh, nutritious food regardless of their circumstances. We serve with compassion, respect, and cultural sensitivity.

missionStatement.heading: Our Mission: No One Goes Hungry
missionStatement.text: At the Canadian and African Women Aid Program (CAWAP), we believe that access to nutritious food is a fundamental human right. Our Food Bank serves as a lifeline for families and individuals facing food insecurity, providing not just sustenance, but dignity, hope, and a pathway to stability.

whatWeProvide.heading: What We Provide
whatWeProvide.text: Our Food Bank offers a comprehensive range of nutritious food options and support services to meet the diverse needs of our community members.
whatWeProvide.text2: Weekly deliveries of fresh fruits, vegetables, and seasonal produce from local farms and partners.
whatWeProvide.label: Organic vegetables
whatWeProvide.text3: Essential non-perishable items including grains, proteins, and pantry staples for balanced nutrition.
whatWeProvide.text4: Hot, nutritious meals prepared with care and cultural sensitivity for immediate consumption.
whatWeProvide.text5: Specialized nutrition support for infants, toddlers, and children to ensure healthy development.
whatWeProvide.text6: Workshops and resources to help families make the most of their food and develop healthy habits.
whatWeProvide.text7: Immediate assistance for families facing urgent food crises with same-day service available.

impactStories.heading: Stories of Hope & Transformation
impactStories.text: Real stories from community members whose lives have been touched by the CAWAP Food Bank.
impactStories.text2: "When I lost my job, I didn't know how I would feed my children. CAWAP Food Bank not only provided us with nutritious food but treated us with such dignity and respect. They helped me get back on my feet."
impactStories.text5: "As a senior on a fixed income, the rising cost of food was overwhelming. The volunteers here are like family. They remember my dietary needs and always have a kind word."
impactStories.text8: "As a newcomer to Canada, finding culturally appropriate food was challenging. CAWAP understands our needs and provides food that feels like home. They've been a blessing to our family."

statistics.heading: Our Impact by the Numbers
statistics.text: Every number represents a family fed, a child nourished, and hope restored.

howToHelp.heading: How You Can Help
howToHelp.text: Your support makes it possible for us to serve our community. Here are ways you can make a difference:
howToHelp.text2: Drop off non-perishable food items at our center. We especially need rice, pasta, canned proteins, and baby food.
howToHelp.text3: Financial contributions help us purchase fresh produce and maintain our operations. Every dollar counts.
howToHelp.text4: Join our team of dedicated volunteers. Help sort food, serve clients, or assist with special events.

callToAction.heading: Need Food Assistance?
callToAction.text: Don't hesitate to reach out. We're here to help you and your family with dignity, compassion, and respect. No one should go hungry.
